source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: We have given you, O Prophet, abundant good in this world and the Hereafter — among it the river of Al-Kawthar in Paradise, whose banks are tents of hollow pearl and whose mud is musk.
tafsir.muyassar-2: So devote all your prayer sincerely to your Lord, and sacrifice your offering to Him alone, in His name only.
tafsir.muyassar-3: Indeed, the one who hates you and hates the guidance and light you brought is the one cut off, severed from all good.
